name: Conical Frustum Integral Derivations
aliases: Moments of the uniform distribution over a conical frustum
definition: A parameterization of an axis-aligned cone used to derive moments for the uniform distribution over a conical frustum, defined as (x, y, z) = φ(r, t, θ) = (rt cos θ, rt sin θ, t) for θ ∈ [0, 2π), t ≥ 0, |r| ≤ r˙.
